professional_bio: Priya Menon is a Business Analyst specializing in consulting with expertise in business reporting, stakeholder coordination, and process documentation. She holds an MBA in Business Analytics from Anna University and is proficient in SQL, Excel, and Power BI. Priya has contributed to internal process improvement initiatives by developing dashboard prototypes and process maps, enhancing reporting accuracy and turnaround times. She is recognized for improving documentation quality and mentoring junior analysts, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to operational excellence.
about_me: As a Business Analyst with a strong foundation in business analytics, I transform complex business requirements into actionable insights that drive process improvements and reporting efficiency. My experience in consulting environments has equipped me with skills in stakeholder communication, requirements gathering, and data visualization using SQL, Power BI, and Excel. I am passionate about bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring clarity and alignment throughout project lifecycles. I am eager to leverage my MBA specialization and practical experience to contribute to consulting projects that demand analytical rigor and collaborative problem-solving.
